setup_cmd: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ninja-build gcc-arm-none-eabi
build_cmd: laze build --global -b nrf52840dk -a hello-world && find build/bin/nrf52840dk -path '*/out/memory.x' -exec cp {} memory.x \; && mkdir -p build/bin/nrf52840dk/hello-world && cp build/bin/nrf52840dk/cargo/*/release/hello-world build/bin/nrf52840dk/hello-world/hello-world.elf
